result:
All required deliverables are in place and verified working end-to-end.

**Summary**: Using DANDI:000039 (Allen Institute two-photon calcium imaging of mouse visual cortex, drifting gratings at 8 directions/6 contrasts), I pooled 114 ROIs across 10 sessions, computed orientation/direction selectivity indices (OSI/DSI) and Kruskal-Wallis significance per cell, and found 58% were significantly direction-tuned, with preferred directions tiling the full range and a clear diagonal structure in the sorted population tuning-curve heatmap — the expected signature of orientation selectivity.

Outputs in the working directory: `orientation_selectivity_analysis.py` (jupytext script, ran end-to-end in ~21s using the warm remfile cache), `orientation_selectivity_analysis.ipynb` (executed, no errors), 5 figures (`fig1`-`fig5`), and `README.md`.
